newsitem.title: UK: Country Casuals sells units, sees writedown.
newsitem.headline: Country Casuals sells units, sees writedown.

text.p: British clothing retailer Country Casuals Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it agreed to dispose of its loss-making Elvi and Lerose Manufacturing businesses to those units' management.
The company said it expected the potential writedown of net assets to be less than 5.0 million stg.
Country Casuals said its core business had made a strong start to the year, with like-for-like sales growing nine percent in the first 16 weeks of trading.

"The board believes that the disposal of these loss-making businesses is imperative if the full potential of the profitable core Country Casuals business is to be achieved," the company said in a statement.
